description: Public provenance of an invented raw native transport transcript, including every captured input and response byte. This is test evidence of transport behavior, not a public engineering-model dataset or a disposition of the importer's inner runtime provenance.
source_name: SWBPIPE project-original invented desktop MBF transport capture
source_license: MIT (repository LICENSE); project-original invented fixture inputs and generated transcript
contributor_certification: All captured models, records, mapping descriptions and protocol metadata derive solely from the identified project-invented export model, the recorded project-authored settings and material declaration, and SWBPIPE's native export/save/import code. No supplier program, vendor table, private engineering model or protected input produced any captured byte.
origin: invented for the DEL-17-04 desktop MBF raw native transport fixture
coverage_rule: The seven provenance fields above apply to the complete transcript, all bytes identified by every covered input (including the entire source model and both saved files), every decoded response byte and every nested model/record in those responses. No captured record has a separate or unlisted data source.
generation_and_binding: The source_model_file_sha256 identifies the entire maintained invented source file; export_settings_json is the exact project-authored export setting text used by both the fixture writer and native command flow.

Sandbox::native_pair calls actual native export review/save task 3 and its file transaction. The capture generator reads the saved MBF and adjacent identity file, checks them byte for byte against the maintained invented writer pair and its export_digests.json degc-default bindings, then records both SHA-256 values.

For the bound Designate reply the designated model document is the maintained invented source file itself, written byte for byte (its digest is source_model_file_sha256); the designated Adopt reply adopts that designated review.

Native import task 5 opens that actual saved pair for bound replies. The test deliberately removes only that identity file before the unbound replies; declaration_json records the exact serialized per-name project-invented declaration supplied to review and Adopt.

Response callback strings are retained verbatim, without parsing and re-serializing them for storage. The native generator compares the complete maintained fixture byte for byte, and checks source, review and model bindings. The App test setup JSON-parses the response strings unchanged.

File names and protocol constants are project-authored test parameters; hashes, units, identities, assumptions, diagnostics and imported records are derived by the identified native code from these covered invented inputs. No temporary host path is captured.
limits: The inner imported material provenance is preserved exactly as the runtime emits it; it can be partial and is not asserted to have seven public-data fields. String encoding alone grants no public disposition: this explicit invented-source coverage is the transcript's disposition. The generic committed-public-model scan is unchanged, and other public engineering-model datasets retain all seven fields per provenance record. Independent data-boundary scrutiny, exact-head CI and the PR-specific publication consultation remain required; no engineering acceptance or release is claimed.
